create_Joystick_env: create a Joystick environment instance for tracking joystick commands on a Berkeley Humanoid robot
build_default_config: build a default configuration dictionary for the Joystick locomotion task with reward scales and noise settings
run_sample_command: run the sample_command method to generate random linear and angular velocity commands for the humanoid
test_step_simulation: test the step method to simulate one control step with random pushes and action execution
review_get_obs_observation: review the _get_obs method that constructs noisy and privileged observation vectors for the environment
